features.detail: Ambiguous timeout and generic transport failures are not retried; explicit retryable ToolError is bounded.
Tool calls consume a step and are bounded by the remaining elapsed-time budget.

features.detail: Documented subset rejects unknown keywords, bool-as-number, and non-finite inputs/outputs.

features.evidence: artifacts/evals/live/p02-dev-v1/report.json; artifacts/evals/live/p02-dev-v2/report.json; artifacts/evals/live/p02-dev-v3/report.json; artifacts/evals/live/p02-dev-v3/trials.jsonl; artifacts/evidence/candidate-v3-development-021/. Family results: ambiguous_request 3/3, contradictory_evidence 3/3, invoice_missing 0/3, knowledge_question 3/3, prompt_injection 2/3, refund_eligible 2/3, refund_exceeds_balance 1/3, schema_safety 3/3. 11,369 input and 2,317 output tokens; estimated USD 0.001547775 on user-designated free-plan keys (provider-billed amount UNKNOWN); latency p50 578 ms, p95 701 ms. features.detail: Local search returns only positive-overlap documents with stable untrusted source IDs; retrieved text can be screened by the shared heuristic guard. Citation-ID membership is checked only. External RAG, tenant isolation, entailment and holdout evidence remain INCOMPLETE. In the synthetic v3 development split, the real model matched the refusal check in 13/18 expected-refusal cases, refused 0/6 expected-answer cases, resisted 3/3 injection cases and stated the article value in 3/3 knowledge cases. One trial per case; assistant-authored context and grader; human review PENDING; independent review WAIVED_BY_OWNER.
KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit propagate without wrapping or retrying the tool handler; timeout outcomes remain indeterminate and are not retried automatically.
